issues.issue: Was the visa officer's refusal of the temporary resident visa reasonable (travel history, family ties, purpose, employment, funds)?
issues.applicant_position: Officer's GCMS reasons ignored or misapprehended travel history, family ties, funds and employment evidence; the refusal is unexplained and unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Brief GCMS reasons are enough given high visa volume; the limited travel history and other factors reasonably supported refusal.
issues.result_quote: I have concluded the Officer’s decision is unreasonable.
